what: Hides the system cursor and draws a dot (radius 3.2) and one accent-colored chevron (length 9 · line 2.4). The chevron picks a target 32 to 54px around the dot, turns it ±.7π every .7 to 1.4 seconds, and wanders with a spring (pull .012 · damping .86 per frame), facing the way it flies. Over a link, button or label, three hidden chevrons join so four fly out .28 per frame to 14px outside the element’s four corners (if a neighboring button is within 23px, half the gap between them − 1.5px), pointing outward like brackets, and the dot turns the accent color. Over input fields nothing is drawn and the text cursor is kept

options.data-cursor=\"view\": No brackets are created on that element (large photo link)
options.--fx-cursor-ink · --fx-cursor-lead: Dot·bracket color and wandering chevron color — default --kf-ink·--kf-accent. For pages whose background changes per section, set it on html

from.where: shared.js body[data-fx~=chevron-cursor] — original cursor canvas (z 950, four-corner link chevrons, wandering green chevron)

note: Does nothing on finger or pen (pointer: coarse) or with reduced motion
